description.describe_ch: 本課程將介紹永續城市、住宅和建築的設計原則，探討永續土地利用和農業的特點、挑戰和解決方案，以及水資源管理和能源利用的相關知識，以實現永續發展。學生將學習如何運用所學知識，設計出具有永續性的城鄉與家園規劃方案。
description.describe_eh: This course will introduce the design principles of sustainable cities, dwellings and buildings, explore the characteristics, challenges and solutions of sustainable land use and agriculture, and knowledge related to water resource management and energy use to achieve sustainable development. Students will learn how to apply what they have learned to design sustainable urban, rural and home planning solutions.
